name: 1.0.0 Beta
body:
- Tabs implemented
- Numerous bugs fixed with file operations (move/copy/delete)
- Properly handling symlinks/junctions
- Image viewer can now zoom and pan. "Copy to clipboard as displayed" command added that copies just what you see in the window
- Text viewer: encoding detection improvement, UI improvements
- Ctrl+Home (Cmd+Home on Mac) to jump to the first file - useful when you have a ton of folders before files
- LTO enabled on all platforms (minor performance optimization)
- Shift+F3 to force view current file in the text viewer, regardless of file type ([19a2c66](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/19a2c665fde2cdcf4396fbed837a04105ce09c65))
- Ctrl+Shift+X now copies all selected items paths (if more than 1) ([982e96a](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/982e96a4af7a8880342ec91e5d4f9a700d8a2c94))
- Fixed incorrect reporting of cursor position to plugins (no more "Nothing happens when I press F3") ([d68dfc8](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/d68dfc8a957d924dad85eee4d08621fef9a84fec))
- Calculate stats (Ctrl+L): multi-threaded ([51d7516](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/51d7516644afe7e54b8883888f2394dc0c6b9951))
- Linux: proper volume enumeration ([3f8dd94](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/3f8dd94bb8884bb2a8d507f73adf85b8e4589419))
- Env variable expansion on Linux/Mac fixed ([c3cd461](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/c3cd461b23eb3b3e39eb1e448355647aa634d21c))
- Ctrl+Shift+V: JPG quality increased to 75 ([3536a22](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/3536a22fa91e4ccc64048ff9b55a65e7fcb693bc))
- And more small fixes and improvements

- File search: support multiple name filters, semicolon ;-separated ([3011ed6](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/3011ed68b52039548a5ede31acd6eb7c0a6d6a0b))
- Text viewer: search implemented in the "fast" mode ([1ba9903](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/1ba9903a81ec08151a30f75ba3b7c6aeea5da61c))
- Windows installer optimized ([644d76b](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/644d76b95d30f1e91fab4ba281f9247f40909879))
- Pasting images as JPG with Ctrl+Shift+V ([369753c](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/369753cc4d8e1a2e6a3bf4f2d18f744afd506410))
- Text viewer: content type and encoding detection fixed ([96d035d](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/96d035d2e9030174a1e9121e3f6735734b6e1bde))

- Text viewer: a special fast mode for large files and binary files
- Text viewer: HEX viewing mode (very fast for large files) 
- Text viewer: displaying the detected content type
- Text viewer: syntax highlighter added
- Advanced statistics collection and display for Ctrl+L
- Image viewer: pixel-perfect drawing of the images; bug fixes for display scaling
- Copy/move dialog: UI bugs and overall layout fixed
- Many small improvements and bug fixes

- Search window: context menu with the option to copy item path to clipboard (closed #144) ([b80fe84](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/b80fe8402313f4c3abd0a3123370916b93942438))
- Search window: window size behavior fixed (closed #180) ([56cf09f](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/56cf09f64fec7f60f0967ca5976743bb0084448d))
- Search window: the drop-down selector behavior improved/fixed ([7e1780e](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/7e1780e3052c881f828fb2316c0be42edb3480d0))
- Windows: incorporating vc_redist ([3a59e64](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/3a59e648c227cfb01a9ba6e3f02699f1168281ab))
- Search window: icons for the search results ([59493dc](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/59493dc5c539287424449db5e16a146ff3c20774))
- Search: "partial match" implemented and ON by default ([9d89f1e](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/9d89f1e6579b2f53b607a04d7a5d55bbfb68ea2d))
- Search window UI fixed ([6b87de8](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/6b87de8a774dc6155085eb2bbd2bc994035c8c05))
- Search window: better UI layout ([a8200ed](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/a8200ed1184cf0d3db6424fe1a797ad2f07fcb30))
- Searching files by contents case-insensitively fixed ([f7d8f40](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/f7d8f409bbe58d90cf1914c0c86e9e88c1a0a140))
- CPanel::navigateBack()/CPanel::navigateForward() silently skips non-existing folders (implemented #335) ([ed36580](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/ed3658082aa8b4d20a4d5f8df0efb0d409966823))
- Implemented Ctrl+C in the image viewer (closed #337) ([4d36346](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/4d3634675a207de9f19393a6b5dd574e856d169a))
- lxterminal supported ([821cacd](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/821cacd8a73fd40dd882aca913793b098d386437))
- Panel contents filter: only updating it on 'Enter' press ([fe9e4ca](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/fe9e4ca13cdbe8da4855143feffabb9d5824b1f4))
- Better detection of image files by the image viewer plugin ([8c157bd](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/8c157bd6367c31586a57d9ce03112e3172318c71))
- Default editor (notepad.exe) on Windows ([6c95779](https://github.com/VioletGiraffe/file-commander/commit/6c9577957fb0fef81e9aaa9b96fc51094d7f4252))

* Performance improvements
* Text viewer now supports HTML and Markdown

* Fixed the infinite update notification
* Fixed the "move" operation leaving empty folders behind

* Drastic performance improvement when entering folders with a large number of items, no more waiting for 3+ seconds.
* Multiple bug fixes and smaller optimizations.
* Ability to save and load search results in the File Search window (the results are stored in plain text, so can be usable by other means as well).
* Prettier changelog in the "Check for updates" dialog.
File copy optimized, UI behavior improved - faster speed for small files and no more un-cancellable jobs.
Windows: fixed the file list not updating on changes.
Numerous bug fixes, some performance improvements, and a few small features.
Numerous performance improvements and bug fixes.
Numerous quality of life and bug fixes.
